landing.title: Know who's who, without losing who's a customer.
landing.lead: Verification links branded as your company, face capture with liveness, and a Fraud Copilot that explains every decision. Built for fintech, lending, agribusiness and automotive.
landing.statLabel: identity fraud attempts blocked in H1 2026 in Brazil (+32.9% YoY)

consent.title: Before you start
consent.subtitle: See what {{org}} will collect and decide.

consent.legal1: {{org}} is the controller of your data and processes your facial biometrics, sensitive personal data, based on your consent (Brazil's LGPD, art. 11), to {{purpose}}.

tutorial.simpleMode: Your browser doesn't support automatic verification. You'll take the photo manually.

cameraError.assisted: I'd rather finish with an agent

not_found.title: No camera found
not_found.body: Use a phone or computer with a camera, or finish with an agent.

ios_safari: Choose Allow and come back to this page.

Come back and tap Try again.

Come back and tap Try again.
desktop_chrome: Click the icon left of the address.
Reload the page if Chrome asks.
desktop_firefox: Click the crossed-out camera icon in the address bar.
desktop_safari: Safari menu → Settings for this website.
other: Open the site settings in your browser.

qualified.subtitle: Approved subjects with a separate marketing opt-in and a Qualification Score of at least {{min}}.
qualified.howTitle: How the Qualification Score is calculated
qualified.howBody: 50% identity confidence (100 − Risk Score), 25% profile completeness and 25% verification recency. Only people who agreed to receive offers are included.
qualified.creditWhy: Why isn't the credit bureau part of this?
qualified.creditWhyBody: Bureau checks require a credit-analysis purpose and are logged. The result is never used for marketing campaigns or the Qualification Score.
qualified.emptyBody: Approved subjects who agreed to receive offers and reached the minimum score show up here.
qualified.bureauConfirmBody: Recorded purpose: credit analysis. The check is recorded in the audit log.
qualified.bureauConfirmBodyName: Subject: {{name}}. Recorded purpose: credit analysis. The check is recorded in the audit log.
qualified.bureauNote: Simulated connector: no data leaves the system and no real company is queried. Result used only for credit, never marketing.

rules.autoApproveHelp: Sessions scoring 0–30 with no mandatory review rule are approved without an analyst. Rejection is never automatic.
rules.impactOn: With this rule, {{low}}% of the {{total}} sessions in the last 30 days would be auto-approved and {{review}}% would go to review.
rules.impactOff: Today all {{total}} sessions in the last 30 days go to review. Turning the rule on, {{low}}% would be auto-approved.
rules.impactEmpty: No sessions in the last 30 days to estimate impact.
rules.depositLimitHelp: Above this, subjects with no history go to review (AML).
rules.bandsNote: Fixed decision bands: 0–30 low, 31–70 review, 71–100 high.
rules.webhookHelp: Public HTTPS URL. We only send opted-in fields, with an HMAC signature header.
rules.dpoHelp: Shown to subjects on the rights page (LGPD).
